item.title: The Great War
item.description:
*War, war never changes*- common knowledge · 0ND · Passed down by word of mouth Long ago, two brothers sailed to the continent of Solea as part of an exploration party. They remained together for some time before deciding to split apart and forge their own paths while building up their respective sides of the continent.
One of the brothers, focused on fairness and honour, founded the Veritas order. Their ethos was Truth and Justice above all. The other brother built up the empire of Aevitas. Their belief was: Prioritise the state above all.The two factions, despite having opposing viewpoints, grew into power at a similar pace. During the reign of the brothers, peace and prosperity spread throughout the land. This, however, was short-lived. The details are lost to the sands of time, and history is but a muddy recollection. After their passing, invasions became more frequent, borders less defined, tension was ever-rising and eventually … War broke out.ᚨ ᛚ ᚨWar is a terrible thing. No one wins in war, even the victor suffers agonising losses. The similar fortitude of Aevitas and Veritas led to a long, unmoving stalemate. Years of bloodshed dragged on with no hint of stopping in sight. That was until the Great Calamity. The story goes that Veritas got their hands on forbidden ancient technology. In their hubris, they activated a catalyst that they believed would end the war.They were right.All that remains of Veritas is a desolate, arcane wasteland, and a large crater where the capital used to be.
Margin Ever since the Great Calamity, arcane storms from the wasteland have been bombarding the inner sea. At its heart, a giant violent maelstrom has been manifesting. Rather than dissipating, it only expands as the years pass. It has been dubbed "The Anomaly" Unknown

item.title: Solea
item.description:
- World Map · 794ND · by unknown cartogapher Solea is a beautiful horseshoe shaped island with an arctic to the south and a gruelling desert to the north. Mountains gently line the edges of the island, while smaller islands are sprawled across the coasts. A volcano lies in the north-west, though it has been quite some time since its last activity.The scale of the continent is massive, taking 100 days and a few to cross from the north to the south, likewise from the west to the east. Crossing the centre is a task easier said than done. You either cross the harsh desert through the mountain pass, sail down the inner sea, or trek the freezing arctic. This geographic split naturally led the way to two main factions controlling a side of the island each.✦ ᛟ ✦Maps are a reflection of the world, they describe what people see. They are however, rarely accurate. In the case of Solea, it has been many moons since the eastern wing was mapped by cartographers. Rumours spread as to why, but nothing is set in stone. The most common interpretation is to cover it in colourful clouds as a nod to the constant arcane storms, save for the crater that is.
Margin Human greed is a fascinating thing! The time they lived together in peace was short-lived before one eventually sent invading forces to expand. That is what's now commonly referred to as The Great War.Unknown
